summary: Brother of Helen (Ferlaino) Cognetti; John's 2nd great-granduncle.
bio: 1920 census: Frank, son, 17, born PA, coal-mine laborer. His PA birth shows Leopoldo was in Scranton by about 1901. Not to be confused with Francesco 'Frank' Ferlaino (d. 2007), a later San Mango-born Scranton resident (Legacy obituary).
